notes: Barebone fanless digital-signage player (mini-PC), 19mm-thick chassis, sold in 4 SKUs sharing identical I/O: DS-081GB-U1A1E (Celeron 3965U), -U2A1E (Core i3 6100U), -U4A1E (Core i5 6300U), -U5A1E (Core i5 7200U, only SKU with Intel AMT on LAN1). Mounting is VESA/Desk/Wall/DIN-rail (not rack-mountable) so rackUnits is omitted. Also has an internal full-size Mini-PCIe slot (mSATA-compliant) for optional WiFi/HSDPA modules, but that is an internal expansion slot, not an external physical port, so it was not listed. Audio jack connector type (trs-3.5 vs. a dedicated mini-TOSLINK) is inferred from the "SPDIF/Line-out/Mic-in + Jack Sense" wording rather than an explicit connector-type callout — flagged as the one lower-certainty item; everything else (HDMI 1.4 x2, RJ-45 x2 Gigabit, USB 3.0 x4, RS-232 x1, 19V DC-in) is directly confirmed by both the spec table and the labeled front/rear panel line drawings in the official Advantech datasheet.

ports.name: LAN 1
ports.note: Intel I219-LM controller; supports Intel AMT on the Core i5-7200U (DS-081GB-U5A1E) SKU only

ports.name: SPDIF/Line-out/Mic-in
ports.note: Single combo audio jack with 'Jack Sense' auto-detect; datasheet lists it as SPDIF/Line-out/Mic-in (one physical jack, function set by driver/adapter)

ports.name: DC-in (19V)
ports.note: 19V DC input; ships with external 19V power adapter and a region-specific 3-pin AC cord (US/EU/UK/Japan/CCC)
